name: @pipeworx/mcp-bookbrainz

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search BookBrainz (MetaBrainz open book database) for works, editions, authors, publishers, series, or edition-groups by free-text query. Returns matching entity records with their BookBrainz UUIDs (bbids) for use with lookup.

type.description: work | edition | author | publisher | series | edition-group

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Fetch a single BookBrainz entity (work, edition, author, publisher, series, or edition-group) by its UUID (bbid), with optional sub-resources (aliases, relationships, identifiers) via the includes parameter.

type.description: work | edition | author | publisher | series | edition-group

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Browse entities of a type filtered by a related entity. e.g. browse editions by work, works by author.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bookbrainz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bookbrainz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
